source.title: Intertwined charge density wave order in vanadium based kagome superconductors
source.version: Article in Press, peer-reviewed accepted manuscript; final edited VoR not yet provided

APS_reference: K. Sun, L. Nie, H. Li, J. Zhao, H. Rao, F. Yu, M. Shi, Z. Xiang, J. Ying, Z. Wang, T. Wu, and X. Chen, Intertwined charge density wave order in vanadium based kagome superconductors, npj Quantum Mater., Article in Press (2026), doi:10.1038/s41535-026-00955-8.
direct_reading_scope: Official HTML citation metadata, abstract, accepted-version notice and article licence
Accepted main PDF pp.1-8 and p.11 extracted text; Figs.1-4 captions, Results, Discussion, Methods, data/code availability and rights

Official 20-page SI: Notes2-5 (pp.4-17) on T* extraction/normalization, geometry and symmetry channels, scalar and symmetry-resolved GL assumptions; selected Notes1 and6 paragraphs on strain and transmission
QSSD arXiv2611.32560v1 sections II.D.1-2, Table2, Fig3 caption, AppendixD/Table5 and AppendixE as an additional bounded independent cross-check

source_findings.measurement: Actual strain-induced resistance measurements on pristine CsV3Sb5, Ti substitution x=0.03/0.05/0.09 at V and Sn substitution y=0.04/0.06 at Sb. Modified Montgomery, two-bar, transverse and uniaxial configurations are compared.
source_findings.T_star_definition: Characteristic kink/local maximum in normalized coefficient, with slope-change treatment for Ti samples and corresponding unnormalized derivative checks; error bars use minimum nearby temperature spacing.
source_findings.exception: At Ti x=0.09 T* approaches T_CDW and the features mix into a zigzag. Do not generalize separate well-resolved transitions to every sample.
source_findings.symmetry: A1g response dominates and E2g does not diverge at T*. The measured A1g combination includes out-of-plane m13/Poisson contributions, not an isolated pure in-plane susceptibility.
source_findings.doping_relationship: T* and middle-point resistive Tc are anticorrelated across the measured series; T_CDW and Tc show no clear common correlation. Ti and Sn substitution affect T* differently.
source_findings.interpretation: The additional incipient electronic order coupled to triple-Q CDW and its competition with superconductivity are phenomenological GL interpretation. T* is not established here as a separate thermodynamic transition, pure nematic order, pure loop-current order or static PDW.
source_findings.data_and_code: Zenodo record14038465 linked; additional data and custom numerical scripts on reasonable request. No scripts executed or original measurements reproduced.
source_findings.strain_transmission: SI distinguishes >=90% PZT-to-gauge transmission from about80% effective sample/device transmission; these must not be merged into one measurement efficiency.
source_findings.avoid_unneeded_numeric_T_star: Main pristine discussion uses around35K while selected RRR SI curves describe25-30K; routine brief need not state a universal numeric T*.

DQB_comparison.overall: The short DQB summary is supported at overview level.
required_editorial_conditions: Identify paper as Article in Press rather than completed final issue/VoR.
Keep the anomaly/measurement separate from the GL microscopic-order interpretation.
If discussing all compositions in detail, retain the Ti0.09 merged-feature exception.
DFT/effective-Hamiltonian validation targets are editorial suggestions, not newly validated calculations in this paper.

rights.article: CC BY4.0, verified at accepted PDFp11 and official HTML; third-party exception language retained

optional_QSSD_independent_crosscheck.Table2: G35m2000, p4,60iterations, 3 hardware runs; mean best cut ratio152qubit ibm_boston0.9829+/-0.0005(95%CI), single SA0.9969, HiGHS2h0.9720. Normalize to best-known cut7687, not proven optimum.
optional_QSSD_independent_crosscheck.heavy_hex: m10000, n152,p8,100iterations, single QPUrun about0.95; SA0.992; HiGHS proves optimum at3310seconds(Table5).
optional_QSSD_independent_crosscheck.fair_comparison: Table5 explicitly says runs were not designed as strict timing benchmark. G35 hardware and single classical baselines are different budgets; no wall-clock quantum speedup follows.
optional_QSSD_independent_crosscheck.uniform_sampler_ablation: AppendixG uses uniform samples on same chosen subspaces and bit-flip postprocessing; bounded source text read, no experimental reproduction.

guideline_application: Actual scientific quantities, strain channel, model and material are connected; avoid replacing an observable anomaly by a discovered order label.
Use original title and all12authors in APS reference. No invented AIP volume or article number.
No new hero, schematic, video or full review required for routine DQB editorial; no extra approval gate introduced.
Korean terms such as reads/shows/bottleneck require context rather than a forbidden-word replacement; retain useful physical conditions in their relevant claim.
not_performed: No full-PDF visual rendering or per-page image review of the main or SI
No raw-data download/analysis or Zenodo payload audit
No author contact, email, external message or experiment
No DFT, free-energy numerical reproduction, material synthesis or quantum-device execution
No public article/body/state/common-file edits or source push
